Class EmulatorBoot

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.infrastructure.EmulatorBoot
public final class EmulatorBoot extends Object
Cold-boot flags and the recycle cadence for a managed Android emulator.

-no-snapshot-save does not drop a snapshot that is loaded at boot. A snapshot or renderer wedge, and a memory-cap kill that leaves the lease half alive, cold-boot with -no-snapshot-load. A healthy emulator is not recycled per method or between suites. The cadence is pressure-or-wedge: no host qemu timing was available when this cut was chosen, so a timer would be an unmeasured number.

    • coldBootAfterCapKill

      public static boolean coldBootAfterCapKill(boolean emulatorAlive, boolean appiumAlive)
      Emulator process gone and Appium still recorded: the memory cap (or a crash) killed qemu. The survivor Appium is owned by the lease and can be stopped so setup can cold-boot. An emulator that is still alive while Appium is gone is not killed here.
